documentTypes.name: Invoice
documentTypes.description: A request for payment from a seller to a buyer: tax invoice, commercial invoice, bill.

documentTypes.name: Credit Note
documentTypes.description: A document reducing or reversing an amount previously invoiced.

documentTypes.name: Purchase Order
documentTypes.description: A buyer's order authorizing a purchase from a vendor.

documentTypes.name: Quotation
documentTypes.description: A seller's price offer or proforma invoice issued before an order.

documentTypes.name: Receipt
documentTypes.description: Proof of a completed payment: till receipt, payment receipt, cash receipt.

documentTypes.name: Bank Statement
documentTypes.description: A periodic account statement listing transactions and balances.

documentTypes.name: Unknown
documentTypes.description: Anything that does not match another configured document type.

fields.name: documentNumber
fields.description: The document's own identifying number: invoice no, credit note no, PO no, quote no, receipt no.

fields.name: referenceNumber
fields.description: Another document this one points to, e.g. the PO number on an invoice or the original invoice number on a credit note.

fields.name: issuerName
fields.description: Legal name of the party that issued the document (seller, vendor, merchant, bank).

fields.name: issuerAddress
fields.description: Full postal address of the issuer, as a single line.

fields.name: issuerTaxId
fields.description: Issuer's tax registration number (VAT, GSTIN, EIN, ABN, TRN, etc.).

fields.name: recipientName
fields.description: Name of the party the document is addressed to (buyer, bill-to, account holder).

fields.name: recipientAddress
fields.description: Full postal address of the recipient, as a single line.

fields.name: documentDate
fields.description: Issue date of the document.

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Payment due date.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the monetary amounts, e.g. USD, EUR, INR.

fields.name: subtotal
fields.description: Total before tax.

fields.name: taxAmount
fields.description: Total tax charged.

fields.name: totalAmount
fields.description: Grand total including tax.

fields.name: lineItems
fields.description: Itemised lines of goods or services.

fields.name: accountNumber
fields.description: Bank account number or IBAN the statement is for.

fields.name: periodStart
fields.description: First date covered by the statement.

fields.name: periodEnd
fields.description: Last date covered by the statement.

fields.name: openingBalance
fields.description: Balance at the start of the period.

fields.name: closingBalance
fields.description: Balance at the end of the period.

fields.name: transactions
fields.description: Statement transaction rows.
